courses.name: Survey of Artificial Intelligence I: Basic Techniques
courses.description: Surveys AI problem solving, knowledge representation and machine learning.
courses.prerequisites: Specialization table: Must have credit for CSE 2331 or 5221; and Math 2568, 2174, 4568, or 5520H; and Stat 3201 or 3450 or 3460 or 3470 or 4201 or Math 4530 or 5530H; and enrollment in CSE, CIS, ECE, or Data Analytics major. Not open to students with credit for 5521. Course directory: 2331 or 5331; and Math 2174 or 2568 or 4568 or 5520H; and Stat 3201 or 3450 or 3460 or 3470 or 4201 or Math 4530 or 5530H; and enrollment in CSE, CIS, ECE or Data Analytics major. Not open to students with credit for 5521.

courses.name: Machine Learning and Statistical Pattern Recognition
courses.description: Introduces classification, clustering, data representation and their theoretical analysis.
courses.prerequisites: Specialization table: Must have credit for CSE 3521, 5521, or 5243; and 5522, Stat 3460, or 3470; and Math 2568, 2174, 4568, or 5520H. Course directory: 3521, 5521, or 5243; and 5522, Stat 3460, or 3470; and Math 2568, 2174, 4568, or 5520H; or Grad standing.

courses.name: Computer Vision for Human-Computer Interaction
courses.description: Studies visual features, segmentation, shape, tracking and motion for interactive systems.
courses.prerequisites: Specialization table: Must have credit for CSE 2331. Course directory: 2331, or Sr or Grad standing. Not open to students with credit for 634.

courses.name: Foundations of Speech and Language Processing
courses.description: Builds systems for written and spoken language using NLP, recognition and synthesis.
courses.prerequisites: Specialization table: Must have credit for CSE 3521 or 5521, and 5522, Stat 3460, or 3470. Course directory: 3521 or 5521, and 5522, Stat 3460, or 3470. Not open to students with credit for 733.

courses.name: Introduction to Neural Networks
courses.description: Surveys perceptrons, radial-basis models, support-vector machines and recurrent networks.
courses.prerequisites: Specialization table: Must have credit for CSE 3521 or 5521. Course directory: 3521 or 5521. Not open to students with credit for 779.

courses.name: Introduction to Data Mining
courses.description: Covers data preparation, classification, clustering, anomalies and network analysis; assumes programming preparation.
courses.prerequisites: Specialization table: Must have credit for CSE 3241 or 5241; and 2331, 5331, Stat 3301, or ISE 3200; and enrollment in CSE, CIS, ECE, Data Analytics, or ISE major. Course directory: 3241 or 5241; and 2331, 5331, Stat 3301, or ISE 3200; and enrollment in CSE, CIS, ECE, Data Analytics, or ISE major.

courses.name: Capstone Design: Knowledge-Based Systems
courses.description: Develops knowledge-based systems through a team design project with technical and communication work.
courses.prerequisites: Specialization table: Must have credit for CSE 3521, or 5521; and 2501, or Philos 1338, or 2338; and CSE 3901, or 3902, or 3903; and GE writing and comm course: level 2, or GE foundation writing and info literacy course. Course directory: 3521 or 5521; and 2501, or Philos 1338 or 2338; and CSE 3901, or 3902 or 3903; and GenEd 1201 or 2601; and GE writing and comm course: level 2, or GE foundation writing and info literacy course; or Grad standing.

requirements.title: AI specialization
requirements.summary: Complete the required course and two listed options. Credits vary if the four-credit capstone is selected.

requirements.title: Parent degree and specialization selection
requirements.summary: A specialization is required within BSCSE or BSCIS; students typically select it when applying to the major and contact an advisor to change it.

requirements.title: Course enrollment conditions
requirements.summary: Meet the prerequisites and enrollment restrictions attached to each listed course. An asterisk on a listed course denotes undergraduate petition eligibility; none of the inspected AI rows is starred.

requirements.title: Relationship to BS CSE technical electives
requirements.summary: The specialization supplies part of the BS CSE technical electives. The parent degree requires 17 technical-elective hours, including 9 CSE hours; these are parent totals, not additional AI-specialization credits.

requirements.title: Relationship to BS CIS technical electives
requirements.summary: The specialization supplies part of the BS CIS technical electives. The parent degree requires 16 technical-elective hours, including 9 CSE hours; these are parent totals, not additional AI-specialization credits.

requirements.title: BS CIS AI preparation exception
requirements.summary: Linear algebra remains required for the AI specialization through CSE 3521 prerequisites even though the general BS CIS core replaces MATH 2568. Use the listed CSE 3521 alternatives; no waiver is inferred.

notes: Partial designation now reflects unresolved enrollment-source discrepancies within the local AI specialization. Required course and choose-two option structure remain mapped; neither whole bachelor degree is certified.
CSE 5914 is one optional four-credit choice, not a universally required capstone for this specialization. Other listed courses carry three credits; no fixed specialization credit total is invented.

Prerequisites and enrollment/duplicate-credit restrictions are preserved from the course table. No AI-row asterisk was present; new starred rows require review rather than assuming undergraduate access.

Parent BS CSE and BS CIS technical-elective totals (17 and 16 hours) are relationship notes, not extra specialization requirements to add. BS CIS AI students still need linear algebra through CSE 3521 preparation.

Other directory entries add standing alternatives or duplicate-credit exclusions. Neither undated source establishes precedence; applicable enrollment rules need authoritative clarification.
